description: Fix all frontend type definitions and every component that accesses the renamed snake_case fields. The core problem: frontend/src/types/index.ts defines interfaces in camelCase but Prisma/backend returns snake_case. This causes all field accesses to return undefined at runtime. This FEAT depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 being complete (so backend types are finalized). Update types/index.ts first, then fix all 12 component/page files that access the changed fields.
steps: Edit d:/Tugas Kuliah/UAS-CC/frontend/src/types/index.ts — replace all camelCase field names with snake_case to match Prisma output: User: isActive→is_active, createdAt→created_at; Category: imageUrl→image_url, isActive→is_active; Product: categoryId→category_id, images→image_urls, isActive→is_active, createdAt→created_at; nested Product.inventory: reservedQuantity→reserved_quantity; CartItem: cartId→cart_id, productId→product_id, priceAtAdd→price_at_add; Cart: userId→user_id, updatedAt→updated_at; Address: remove label field (not in schema), recipientName→recipient_name, postalCode→postal_code, isDefault→is_default; OrderItem: productId→product_id, unitPrice→unit_price; Payment: referenceCode→reference_code, paidAt→paid_at; Order: shippingCost→shipping_cost, createdAt→created_at. Keep AdminStats with totalRevenue/totalOrders/totalProducts/totalCustomers/recentOrders (matches backend after FEAT-001 fix).
